[[File:Captainaccreditedlicense.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] Captain's Accredited License.]]
A '''Captain's Accredited License''' was an official document registered with the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]]. It provided authentication that a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was certified to operate and fly a specific [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. As of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. To obtain one, a person would have to undergo a piloting check and have ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] piloting experience. This experience requirement could be waived with an additional 300 credit payment known as an "expediter fee".<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Captain's Accredited License was first introduced and visually depicted in the [[1995]] release ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''.<ref name="PSG" />
